choices: It does not compile - null cannot be assigned to a String
explanation: null is not an empty string - it is the absence of any string at all, so there is no object to call isEmpty() on and the call throws. An empty string "" is a real object that happily answers isEmpty() with true. Check for null first, or use a form that tolerates it.
